readme_text:
# WARNING: flashing white light; do not autoplay

Single full 640x640 square, no gutters/quadrants/audio. Exactly 300 seconds at 120 fps.
White [255,255,255] during original Vitality pulse ON; black during pulse OFF.
Source off intervals 0-1.5s and 298-300s stay black. Original frequency, duty and accumulated phase are retained.
Software intensity 1.0 is uncalibrated; short pulses may be missed at 120 fps. No duty clamp.
Exploratory engineering render; no safety, physiological, therapeutic or Nova-equivalence claim.
limitations: Single-square geometry and full software intensity are Generator choices, not a calibrated physical Nova reproduction.
120 fps frame sampling may omit short pulses; original duty is not increased.
No exposure-safety, physiological or therapeutic claim.
